module.Title: Control-Room Startup Challenge
module.Teaching: Combine variables, input, numeric conversion, arithmetic, Booleans, and output into one startup summary.
module.TargetCode:
facility_name = "Crystal Cavern"
operator = input("Enter operator name: ")
temperature = 18.5
pressure = 42.0
fan_running = True
print(f"{facility_name} | {operator} | {temperature}°C | {pressure} PSI | Fan: {fan_running}")

module.PredictionQuestion: What does the f before the final string allow?
PredictionOptions: Variables can be inserted with braces
module.PredictionExplanation: An f-string inserts expressions written inside braces.
